name: Eucalyptus of the Centro de Saude

location.address: East side of the Estrada de Saboia (EN 266), opposite the Centro de Saude, Monchique

access: Stands beside the public road at the village exit towards Saboia, opposite the health centre; seen from the pavement. No entry needed.
transport: Monchique village; bus Portimao to Monchique takes 40 to 50 minutes, the tree is at the edge of the village.
verify_notes: Via Algarviana 'Rota das Arvores Monumentais' guide (Arvores da Vila circuit, tree 2, guide p.7), measured 2010: two Eucalyptus globulus, 37.6 m and 40.0 m tall, girth at 1.30 m 4.9 m and 6.1 m (girth_cm and height_m here are the larger of the pair), base girth 5.8 m and 5.5 m, crown 23.5 m and 27.5 m N-S, 24.1 m E-W. East of the Estrada de Saboia opposite the Centro de Saude, at the village exit towards Saboia and Lisboa. A third eucalyptus of the group fell on 26 Jan 2013, a week after storms; the guide says the two remaining larger ones survived and were awaiting classification as Arvores de Interesse Publico (classification 'Pendente'). ICNF's current classified-tree KML (si.icnf.pt/kml/arv_class, fetched 2026-11-02) lists no eucalyptus in Monchique, so classification has NOT been found; do not say classified. Pin: OpenStreetMap natural=tree node 6471090226 'Eucalipto do Centro de Saude' (Eucalyptus globulus, height 37, crown 27, denotation natural_monument; node v2 edited 2026-05-23). It is one tree-level node for the 37 m tree; the second (taller) tree stands close by and is not mapped. Whether the node was surveyed or taken from the guide is unknown, so the pin is flagged. Alive: no dated photo or observation found (lifecheck NONE, no Commons geotag within 300 m, no iNaturalist record); the only recent trace is the 2026 OSM edit. Flagged: one source plus an OSM node, alive not independently dated. No photo candidate found. Guide also records a garden with camellias and hydrangeas on the other side of the road at the health centre.
